# telnyx_phone_numbers_messaging_settings (Data Source)

The messaging settings of the phone numbers in the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_messaging_profile_id` (String)
- `filter_phone_number` (String)
- `filter_phone_number_contains` (String)
- `filter_type` (String) One of `longcode`, `shortcode`, `tollfree`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_phone_number` (String) One of `asc`, `desc`.

### Read-Only

- `phone_numbers_messaging_settings` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings))

<a id="nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_numbers_messaging_settings`

Read-Only:

- `country_code` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `eligible_messaging_products` (List of String) The messaging products that this number can be registered to use
- `features` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings--features))
- `health` (Attributes) High level health metrics about the number and it's messaging sending patterns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings--health))
- `id` (String) Identifies the type of resource.
- `messaging_product` (String) The messaging product that the number is registered to use
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Unique identifier for a messaging profile.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization that owns this phone number.
- `phone_number` (String) +E.164 formatted phone number.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with this phone number.
- `traffic_type` (String) The messaging traffic or use case for which the number is currently configured.
- `type` (String) The type of the phone number
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

### Nested Schema for `phone_numbers_messaging_settings.features`

Read-Only:

- `mms` (Attributes) The set of features available for a specific messaging use case (SMS or MMS). Features can vary depending on the characteristics the phone number, as well as its current product configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings--features--mms))
- `sms` (Attributes) The set of features available for a specific messaging use case (SMS or MMS). Features can vary depending on the characteristics the phone number, as well as its current product configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings--features--sms))

<a id="nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings--features--mms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_numbers_messaging_settings.features.mms`

Read-Only:

- `domestic_two_way` (Boolean) Send messages to and receive messages from numbers in the same country.
- `international_inbound` (Boolean) Receive messages from numbers in other countries.
- `international_outbound` (Boolean) Send messages to numbers in other countries.


<a id="nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings--features--sms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_numbers_messaging_settings.features.sms`

Read-Only:

- `domestic_two_way` (Boolean) Send messages to and receive messages from numbers in the same country.
- `international_inbound` (Boolean) Receive messages from numbers in other countries.
- `international_outbound` (Boolean) Send messages to numbers in other countries.



<a id="nestedatt--phone_numbers_messaging_settings--health"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_numbers_messaging_settings.health`

Read-Only:

- `inbound_outbound_ratio` (Number) The ratio of messages received to the number of messages sent.
- `message_count` (Number) The number of messages analyzed for the health metrics.
- `spam_ratio` (Number) The ratio of messages blocked for spam to the number of messages attempted.
- `success_ratio` (Number) The ratio of messages sucessfully delivered to the number of messages attempted.
